THE writeGauntletSave FLIP, AND WHY IT IS NOT A KEEP. This is the one row that DIVERGED from run 51 (which measured 149 -> 170, a regression) and it is the reason the re-probe was worth its two builds. Probed in isolation as P3 -- propagation ON for writeGauntletSave alone, nothing else in the file changed -- it measures real 137 -> 108, and it is still a REGRESSION on the arbiter: FRESH fuzzy 93.0158% -> 92.5947%, -0.4211 local, measured by `probe.py game/sys/memcard writeGauntletSave --fuzzy` on both states. Instruction-count parity moves the wrong way too (target 190; ours 191 -> 192), and the opcode-multiset token count worsens 7t -> 12t. This is claim.law.real-can-underweight... running in its less common direction and it is exactly the case AGENTS.md discipline 9(c) describes: a real improvement that fresh fuzzy calls a loss. Note for tooling: `defake_gate check` printed this row as `IMPROVED writeGauntletSave real 137 -> 108` with no fuzzy arbitration, while it DID attach an 'arbitrate on fuzzy' note to the loadGauntletSave REGRESSION row -- the gate arbitrates regressions and reports improvements bare, so an improvement row is the one a lane is most likely to bank unchecked.

WHAT THIS SAYS ABOUT RETAIL. The apparent sloppiness -- an `off` with no `reset` -- is the correct and intended configuration for this TU, and the census in the sibling claim record strengthens that reading: the opener sits above the FIRST function definition in the file and covers all 30 compiled functions, which is what a TU-wide setting looks like, not what a lost bracket looks like. Retail's memcard.c was compiled with propagation off throughout.

That combination -- real down, structure up -- is the signature of a function whose residual is a COUNT problem the pragma trades against, not a propagation problem. The untried idea is to take the -29 real WITHOUT the pragma: read the P3 diff for which of the 12 multiset tokens the propagation change actually removed, and find the source spelling that removes those same words while keeping O at 191 or taking it to 190.
